choices.question: What device will you charge? (which phone or laptop model)
options: a USB-C laptop (tell me which laptop; check your laptop's required single-port wattage)

choices.question: Wired charging or magnetic wireless charging?
options: magnetic wireless charging (only if attaching the bank to your phone is important to you)

choices.question: Does a built-in cable matter to you, or will you carry a separate cable?
options: separate charging cable ("you'll need a cable")
built-in USB-C cable ("if you forget cables" / "if you hate carrying cables")

choices.question: How will you use it: everyday carry or trips?
options: long trips or multiple devices (worth the extra bulk)
travel: one item instead of a wall charger, cable, and power bank
travel and work, in a backpack

choices.question: What's your budget?
options: pay more for convenience (retractable cable, display)

split_by: capacity: 10,000mAh (everyday phone charging; pocketable; roughly 1–2 phone charges), 20,000mAh (long trips, multiple devices, USB-C laptop; noticeably heavier, less pocket-friendly), 20,000–25,000mAh (laptop), 25K (all-in-one for travel and work)

output watts: at least 20W / 20–30W USB-C PD (everyday phone), 30W (plenty for many phones), 45W (faster output for compatible phones; a phone won't charge at 45W unless it supports the necessary protocol), at least 65W USB-C (laptop), 100W to one device (USB-C laptop or Steam Deck), 130W combined (multiple devices), 165W (four-device charging)

cable: separate cable (P50; you'll need a cable), built-in USB-C cable (if you forget or hate carrying cables), longer retractable cable (upgraded / convenience), folding wall plug (replaces a wall charger for travel; adds bulk)
charging method: wired (wastes less energy), magnetic wireless (only if attaching to the phone matters)
number of devices/ports: USB-C and USB-A ports, two built-in cables and four-device charging (backpack, travel and work)
bank recharge speed: recharges at up to 30W (check how quickly the bank recharges, not just advertised capacity)
independent test results: about 1.7 full iPhone 17 charges and 71% in 30 minutes (prioritized over advertised capacity)
price: about $30 (good buy / budget), $59.99 (costs more for the same capacity and output), $83.95 (premium hard to justify for ordinary commuting)
